newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel mutual funds post positive April returns.
newsitem.headline: Israel mutual funds post positive April returns.

text.p: Returns of Israeli mutual funds rose on average in April as a result of higher share prices and a stable bond market, Meitav Investments and Securities said in a report published on Thursday.
The general index of mutual funds calculated by Meitav rose 2.2 percent in April, with most of the funds posting positive real returns of over one percent, the report said.
In the first three months of the year the general index of mutual funds as calculated by Meitav rose by 11.6 percent, with most of the funds giving positive real returns.

The report said that since the beginning of the year the stock market's general share index rose by 21.2 percent. Bonds posted yields of more than 3.6 percent, which is the estimated rate of inflation in the first four months of 1997.
